dates: (b.1810/11)
---

cousin of CMY

She was the daughter of Captain George Crawley and CMY’s aunt and godmother Charlotte (Yonge) Crawley, later Jones; she married the Rev.

Hugh Polson; her daughter Georgiana Alethe married Charles Warren Adams.
